quarterly_data.quarter: Quantinuum press release: Quantinuum and BMW Group Expand Landmark Quantum Computing (05-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Quantinuum and BMW Group expanded their collaboration (joint research since 2021 on industrial chemistry for next-generation mobility) into a multi-year partnership applying quantum computing to advanced materials science; under the agreement BMW Group will use successive generations of Quantinuum's quantum computers - the current Helios system and the upcoming Sol (planned for 2027) and Apollo (planned for 2029) - including catalyst chemistry research on oxygen reduction reactions at platinum catalysts.
quarterly_data.figure: Sol planned for 2027; Apollo planned for 2029
